summary: Reconstructed the figure as a trapezoid ABCD with solid edges, compiled as version 1 (best version). Vertices came from bind_point_labels (A=(67.4,243), B=(460.4,243), C=(381.6,46), D=(146.4,46) px), with y flipped and scaled at 0.02 cm/px. detect_circles found no circles or arcs, and detect_right_angle_marker found no verified right-angle marks, so none are drawn. The critic scored it 0.93 and reported only low-severity issues: label offsets are slightly looser than the original and the overall scale differs.
